title: Four-phase dry engine metric sensitivity control

protocol.self_policy: Each phase versus phase zero: lag 0, fixed gain 1 and separately one RMS gain from note 36 only. Original MIDI time intervals retain common renderer latency.
protocol.hardware_policy: Fixed physical 35 ms lag: round(93 + 44.1 - 1543.5) = -1406 samples. One RMS gain from note 36 per phase, plus fixed baseline phase-zero gain sensitivity. No best-phase selection.
protocol.qualification: Same synthesis parameters apart from waveform origin; phase can change finite-window statistics and actual note/filter transients. This control cannot prove phases are inaudible or establish hardware equivalence.

metric_definition.stft: Hann, hop window/4, no boundary extension or padding; restart independently inside each declared interval
metric_definition.rms: 10 and 50 ms windows, 220-sample hop; P95 of absolute log envelope difference over pairwise union-active windows
metric_definition.legacy_mean: Unweighted mean of SC for 512, 2048, 8192; unchanged by adding 1024
metric_definition.log_activity: Pairwise union at -60 dB of reference spectral peak, floor -80 dB. Counts retained; neither active masks nor log errors are assumed phase invariant.
metric_definition.claims: These distances are diagnostics, not percent audible mismatch or registered equivalence limits.
